description: This file appears to be a C header file (.h) containing function prototypes, comments, and licensing information related to LZS compression and decompression functions. It defines interface functions for LZS compression and decompression, along with associated initialization, but does not contain implementations or class definitions.

methods.name: LZS_InitHistory
methods.description: Initializes the history buffer for LZS compression/decompression using a scratch memory area.

methods.name: LZS_Compress
methods.description: Compresses data from source handle to destination handle with specified source and destination counts, using scratch space, flags, and performance parameters.

methods.name: LZS_Decompress
methods.description: Decompresses data from source handle to destination handle with specified source and destination counts, using scratch space and flags.
